title: sesleria orbelica
intro: Sesleria orbelica, commonly known as Balkan hair-grass, is a type of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. Sesleria orbelica contains bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
